niche_preference_profile: This user tends to prefer clean, restrained interfaces with spacious layout, simple card-based structure, and minimal decorative treatment. They repeatedly favor purple or cool-toned accents, muted gray/lavender or soft dark-blue backgrounds, and clear visual hierarchy with crisp controls, consistent icons, and distinct content visibility. They generally like understated sans-serif presentation, centered modal compositions, and simple data/form styling over flashy, dense, ornamental, or overly warm designs.

top_7_criteria.description: Prefers open spacing, breathing room, clear separation between sections, and less crowded layouts.
Prefers muted, understated, low-clutter interfaces with minimal ornament, fewer decorative elements, and less visual intensity.
Prefers cool-toned palettes, especially purple accents and gray-lavender or soft dark-blue backgrounds, over warmer pink/red or teal/emerald alternatives.
Prefers soft white cards, plain checkbox/form rows, simple boxed summaries, and compact crisp buttons rather than decorative pills, tinted strips, or high-contrast treatments.
Prefers interfaces where key content is clearly visible and emphasized, such as prominent album art, distinct progress indicators, and strongly dimmed backgrounds behind modals.

Prefers dark or cool-muted background treatments, including dark high-contrast surfaces, soft dark blue gradients, and cool gray-lavender tones over washed-out light gray or warm pale pink backgrounds.
Prefers clean sans-serif text, simple headers, cohesive iconography, and integrated compact control styling over editorial serif styling or mixed, less cohesive controls.
